source_refs.note: 7. Healthcare quality control: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-188.

blocks.text: Sehat ki khidmaat ka miyaar (quality) check aur behtar karne ke liye bhi biostatistics istemal hoti hai. Statistical tools se hospitals tashkhees ke tests ki durusti jaanchte hain, mareezon ke nataij ka record rakhte hain aur medical procedures ko yaksaan (consistent) rakhte hain; is se mareezon ki dekh bhaal behtar hoti hai.
